name: Marcos (deceased)
description: Left each PC the letter and the annotated map. Each player decides what he was to them: friend, mentor, colleague, relative. He was too old to walk the paths he had researched.

name: Archmage Hann
description: Of the Imperial Court. Visited the temple 33 years ago for his own purposes, took two spheres for his "very important work", and sealed the Thing in the tavern cellar.

name: The Last Priest of St. Rylan
description: Carved the plea by the altar, begging travellers not to disturb the ritual or the spheres.

name: The River Spirit
description: Greets anyone crossing at the Old Ford, and answers questions, but only from mid-river.

name: Goblob, The Best Goblin
description: Prophet and hero of the forest goblins. His scrawled teachings circulate; the statue of St. Rylan has been defaced in his image.

name: St. Rylan
description: Follower of Statera, saint of the temple; his symbol is a potter's wheel.
